floor_history.headline: func_8003553C honest pure-C floor 17 -> 4: cheat-asm carrier replaced with pure C; two confirmed levers (may-alias-pinned OT-base load hoisted into a local mid-body; 640-valued store leading the body

Floor 4 -> 2: the pre-jal `addiu $s0,$s0,0x24` residual is CLOSED (keep the old primitive pointer and the advanced pointer both live across ot_Link); the whole function is now one misplaced instructio

frontier.hypothesis: The last instruction is reachable by a shape the hand sweep cannot express — the permuter is the right instrument now that the base is 2 (one instruction) rather than 4 or 17.
frontier.mechanism: The remaining search space is a single instruction's position inside one basic block; decomp-permuter randomizes exactly this (statement order, temp introduction, expression re-association) and a base score of 2 gives it a clean gradient instead of noise.
frontier.next_probe: Build a clean single-function target.o from asm/funcs/func_8003553C.s + tools/decomp-permuter/prelude.inc (function at offset 0, drop the .set gp=64 line) per .claude/rules/difficult-is-not-impossible.md section 3; seed base.c from memory/grind/func_8003553C/candidate.c; run a fresh-seed campaign with tools/permuter_campaign.py, waiting for it IN-TURN via `permuter_campaign.py wait --dir <ws>` and harvesting + `--stop`ing before writing the outcome. NB: run import.py from a subdirectory, not the repo root, or it drops a root-level nonmatchings/ that breaks the driver's scope check.

frontier.hypothesis: The pre-load / post-load store barrier created by the may-aliasing lw of D_800A374C is what pins the 0x10 store, and it can be dissolved by changing the ARGUMENT EXPRESSION rather than the store spelling (struct typing was killed, but the load itself has not been varied).
frontier.mechanism: sched.c's memory-dependence test (lines 834-881) only conflicts when it cannot prove the addresses distinct. The barrier exists because the lw's address is a fixed symbol and the stores' addresses vary off an opaque pointer. Varying how the OT base is obtained — reading it into an s32 local first, indexing an OT array (`ot = &D_800A374C_as_array[0x401C/4]`), or computing the slot address from a pointer-typed declaration of the global — changes the rtx shape of that MEM and may change which side of the disambiguation it lands on, without touching the stores.
frontier.next_probe: Sweep 4-6 spellings of the `ot = (u32 *)(D_800A374C + 0x401C);` line ONLY (s32 local staging; u32* / u32** typed extern for D_800A374C; array-indexed slot; slot address computed after the RGB block from a base read before it) against the score-2 candidate, and objdump each — the diagnostic to watch is whether the six post-load coordinate stores can then be scheduled before the lw, which would let the 0x10 store sit in the post-load source group while li $v1,640 stays at the head.

frontier.hypothesis: Target's `li $v1,640` at the block head with both 640 uses in the post-load group implies the 640 pseudo has a HIGH-PRIORITY consumer near the head that our form lacks — most likely because in the original the two 640 stores are NOT independent leaves but part of a chain the scheduler must start early.
frontier.mechanism: In GCC 2.7.2's list scheduler INSN_PRIORITY is the critical-path length to the end of the block, and stores that must precede the may-aliasing lw inherit the path through lw -> move a1 -> jal. An li whose only consumers are post-load leaves has minimal priority and sinks (measured: it lands mid-RGB-block, score 8). For it to head the block its consumer chain must be longer than a single store.
frontier.next_probe: Read tools/gcc-2.7.2/sched.c's priority computation (`priority()` / `rank_for_schedule`) and confirm the exact tiebreak, then look for a C shape that gives the 640 value a longer dependence chain WITHOUT adding an instruction — e.g. the x1/x3 values feeding an address or a further computed value that target also emits. Cross-check against a matched sibling that builds a primitive the same way (src/text1b.c:15445 uses the same ot_Link idiom) to see how its constants are materialized.
